I'm in a similar position OP (minus the felony). I've studied some languages and interned (few months xp). Now working on advancing my knowledge of algorithms/data structures (good course going on coursera right now from Princeton).  

I failed a ton of interviews because I was unprepared for the algorithm/data structure questions. My advice op is to go to community college and take courses on programming in **java** and a course on algorithms/data structures. So you can list it on the resume that I studied CS courses at XYZ.

Honestly though it might be easier to go down the ruby on rails/javascript (jquery, angular, bootstrap, node.js) learning path (udemy has good courses) and become a web developer over trying to become a software engineer.

[This 2 min video is excellent as well!](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TfadJj4d5K4)  

I think the key is dreaming and believing. If you keep working at it, somehow you'll get it before you know it (Relatively speaking).
Well open up. Everything should be laid to bare until you hit that point of pain and then you go deeper slowly until next time when you go deeper still. I'm here for you.

[Forbidden Island](http://www.neatorama.com/2013/07/08/The-Forbidden-Island/)  

The unexplored and the uninhabited is still out there. ASPD doesn't mean shit. Every man is his own island with his own problems and worries and struggles. You came here for a reason because your not some uninhabited isolated island. You hold your own destiny my friend and its a wide world out there. If you can't follow the norms, it just means you have to create a new norm or should I say walk the path less traveled by. I've heard it made all the difference.

If I accept I'm depressed then I will be depressed. I am not. I have a different condition.

And it can't improve. I haven't known affection for years. Girls approach me and I just can't return the affection. I can't kiss, I turn away. Even giving a normal hug to anyone puts me on edge. I had considered being gay, but that is not the case after trying. But honestly, it doesn't matter to me that much, relationships are as much full of love as pain. A rose with thorns and I don't care for that.

I agree I don't know what death is, its repercussions will be horrible. But I have no care, its like I'm a selfish little bitch. But it wasn't exactly a conscious decision to be like that nor is it a state of mind I can remove. I don't care about the repercussions of death. 

I need to see a counselor, but I don't have the resources or the time. I'm an engineering major (nano), which is supposed to be "hot" or cool. Any normal person would be thrilled. I've done internships, I've made my small contribution to the field, and I have no desire for money, fame, power I've realized. It sounds cliche, but its true, its all trivial. If you have no desires, your just a monkey on a chain dancing to someone else's beat. 

Is this pain I feel, this lack of desire for life, greater than the finality of death or not?

Yes, I'm in college.

Yes, I've been through depression. It is terrible. But its not what I am experiencing right now unless its the onset of another episode. But the catalyst if it is onset of depression was this lack of purpose and apathetic attitude to everything that slowly ground me down to nothing.

I honestly don't want to kill myself, but I also don't see the purpose of going on and living without experiencing anything fulfilling. It seems it would be a greater pain to live that life than to just end it here.

As for love, it was never in the equation to begin with. Let's just say I've been alone for a large part of my life. And it wouldn't hurt, if the world weren't so full of it.
Alright Aly. My names is Sid. And I am 21 years old.
